measurement.cpuWindow: cgroup v2 usage_usec before/after docker start -a of k6; includes small Docker command/idle windows, not only HTTP handler CPU
measurement.coldClock: Docker-host container StartedAt to first complete 200, not process exec

qualificationSettings.csrf: cross-site POST without a same-origin secret token

checker.isolation: owned PID namespace/cgroup; force-removed in finally, independent of Node/browser process groups
